purpose: Route the newly surfaced U.S. Navy Volume Sensor multisensor/data-fusion lineage into Worldshepherd while assigning zero Glob evidence weight to the search-side discovery itself.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, or information item discovered and screened during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or a negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, derivative copies, and repeated records are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: A source surfaced by an unrelated search path is not Glob evidence; search co-occurrence receives zero evidence weight unless an independently verified physical or relational feature is established.

sources.title: Volume sensor: data fusion-based, multi-sensor system for advanced damage control
sources.authors: Susan L. Rose-Pehrsson; Frederick W. Williams; Jeffrey C. Owrutsky; Daniel T. Gottuk; Daniel A. Steinhurst; Christian P. Minor; Stephen C. Wales
sources.authority: U.S. Department of the Navy patent publication
sources.note: Use the modular sensor-suite -> subsystem analysis -> fusion-node -> supervisory-control architecture as a historical shipboard multisensor reference. Particularly relevant are raw-plus-derived feature transport, event-specific fusion, pre-alarm/alarm staging, nuisance-source rejection, one-second networked updates, extensible sensor modalities, and synchronized full-scale testing. Its discovery during a Glob search carries zero Glob-number evidence weight.

sources.title: Volume sensor for damage assessment and situational awareness
sources.authority: Fire Safety Journal / U.S. Navy Advanced Damage Countermeasures research
sources.note: Use as a peer-reviewed multisensor prototype precedent combining video, spectral, acoustic, image-recognition, and data-fusion methods for real-time damage assessment. Map the heterogeneous sensor and nuisance-rejection methodology into Worldshepherd sensor-fusion replay and validation cases rather than treating it as Glob evidence.

sources.title: Video image fire detection for shipboard use
sources.authors: D. T. Gottuk; J. A. Lynch; S. L. Rose-Pehrsson; J. C. Owrutsky; F. W. Williams
sources.authority: Fire Safety Journal / Office of Naval Research-supported testing
sources.note: Use the 280 full-scale ship-compartment tests, camera/lighting perturbations, flaming/smoldering cases, nuisance sources, and benchmarking against ionization/photoelectric detectors as a validation-design precedent. Its controlled nuisance cases are especially useful for false-positive and robustness methodology.

sources.title: Volume Sensor Development Test Series 4 Results — Multi-Component Prototype Evaluation
sources.note: Use as the detailed prototype-test lineage behind the peer-reviewed Volume Sensor work. Preserve test configuration, synchronized event timing, sensor modalities, event/nuisance labels, and prototype-vs-commercial comparisons as a candidate benchmark schema for Worldshepherd multisensor validation.

integration_actions.action: Use the Volume Sensor architecture as a precedent for retaining both raw sensor measurements and subsystem-derived features, carrying timestamps and provenance to a fusion layer, and emitting bounded pre-alarm/alarm classifications with replayable evidence.

Translate shipboard nuisance-source testing (lighting variation, welding/grinding/cutting, camera degradation, background activity) into controlled negative and robustness tests for Worldshepherd sensing and anomaly-classification pipelines.

discovery_scope_boundary.rule: A citation appearing only inside a screened source is recorded as a bibliographic lead only when it is materially relevant; it is not promoted to a fully ingested source until its own content is screened. This prevents recursive bibliography expansion from being mistaken for evidence acquisition.
discovery_scope_boundary.worldshepherd_use: ECHO_SENTINEL_LINK maintains the lead/provenance distinction; PRIME_SENTINEL prevents unscreened references from contributing evidence weight.

next_actions: Use the Navy Volume Sensor test architecture to strengthen Worldshepherd sensor-fusion validation design while retaining application-specific boundaries.
Keep W II full-graph topology/relational analysis as the active Glob evidentiary gate; unrelated sensor-fusion sources contribute zero Glob evidence weight.
Apply multiple-testing or false-discovery correction across all Glob species, datasets, targets, tolerances, and relational motifs before any statistical promotion.
